W.note: A 280px single-row toggle with a clean timeline panel, aria-expanded, a labelled region, Escape that returns focus, and a sticky exception with next actions; the open state is smooth but the collapsed row shows no tracking number.

X.note: The collapsed pill is tidy, but the open panel is large (about 316 by 440) and simply appears with no transition, and it has no timeline, only a progress bar, chip and Next step button.

Y.note: The richest tracking content (filters, 5-step timeline, ETA, tracking number, next scan) on a good dark surface, but every click re-renders the whole innerHTML so keyboard focus is lost, the live region wraps the whole panel, and it ships open so the at-rest state is not collapsed.

Z.note: A 52px status row with an unseen count, a smooth ease-out rail timeline with expected windows, an exception that sits on its step, history, a live region and focus restore on Escape and Dismiss, and auto-collapse to a pill.
